payload.reason: The evidence provides specific information about the baseline systems used in the study, including the types of data and methods employed.

claims.text: The baseline systems include traditional phrase-based statistical machine translation (SMT) and a neural machine translation (NMT) system.
The training data for the baseline systems consists of KyTea-segmented Japanese texts and pyvi-segmented Vietnamese texts.
The aim of the NMT systems is to serve as a reproducible baseline for further research.
